mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.15% signals an ultra-loose monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital flows into equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.15% during the 2005-2024 period, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% triggers a labor market recovery signal where declining joblessness accelerates consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 9.5%) or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 600) and industrial production (INDPRO < 90) signals a demand shock that triggers inventory destocking, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where both HOUST < 600 and INDPRO < 90, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 220 (annualized inflation > 2.5%) during a post-shock recovery phase triggers equity risk premium compression, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 220) or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) rising above 1.5% annualized rate signals sustained economic expansion that increases corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate falling below 0.2% during a liquidity crisis triggers a flight-to-quality effect that compresses equity risk premiums, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.02 in any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS < 129,500) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off behavior, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where both PAYEMS < 129500 and UNRATE > 9.5%, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90 during a manufacturing slowdown triggers inventory adjustment cycles that reduce corporate margins, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 90) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year period.
